summary: iter104 — DOB-on-ID mismatch flow + bright yellow input backgrounds. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_id_docs_dob_iter104.py — 11/11 passing (incl. one real-Gemini synthetic PAN OCR). iter103 regression /app/backend/tests/test_id_docs_names_iter103.py 11/11 + /app/backend/tests/test_id_docs_and_tuition.py 18/18 all still pass (29/29 regression, 40/40 total). Verified: (a) PUT /api/members/{mid}/id-docs accepts {pan_dob,aadhaar_dob,passport_dob} for self and rejects every one with 400 for father/mother/guardian. (b) Upload OCR for person='self' returns detected with expected_dob (app DOB), dob_matches (None when app DOB empty, True/False otherwise) and dob_can_apply (True only when card has a DOB, app DOB is empty, and no higher-priority card has a DOB). (c) POST /self/{card}/use-dob — real Gemini-read PAN DOB auto-stores in people.self.pan_dob; call succeeds only when users.date_of_birth is empty AND card is the current reference. Returns 409 'already has DOB' when app DOB is set, and 409 'use the {higher} DOB — it comes first' when a higher-priority card (e.g. passport) already has a DOB. Empty dob → 400. (d) GET /api/id-docs/name-report self rows include app_dob, ref_card, ref_dob and app_dob_match; each card cell is {name,scan,unread,unreadable,match,dob,dob_match}. Parent rows: birth=null, pan/aadhaar/passport dicts have no dob key, and the top-level app_dob/ref_card/app_dob_match are not emitted. (e) pending_rereads increments for self scans missing name OR missing DOB (not yet tried); parent scans only pend on missing name. (f) iter103 /self/birth/use-dob still works when member has no DOB. Frontend (Playwright on preview, admin login): all four /admin/id-documents tabs render; the Name-mismatch tab is now labelled 'Name & DOB mismatch'; filter dropdown exposes all ten options any/names/dob/nodob/passport/aadhaar/pan/birth/nopassport/all (verified via DOM); 'all' shows 358 rows, 'nodob' shows 123 rows; the self row's DOB column (name-row-{id}-self-app-dob) is rendered 169 times (one per self row). The approvals name filter still works (approvals-name-input visible + yellow). Global yellow input style verified live on 4 pages: login-email-input / login-password-input / members Search by name… input / name-report-search / approvals-name-input all computed background-color = rgb(255,241,118) i.e. #fff176. Code-read verifies IdDocsSection renders id-self-{card}-card-dob (red when cardDob≠wantDob where wantDob = app_dob || first-ref dob), DetectedBar renders id-self-{card}-dob-warning on mismatch and id-self-{card}-use-dob only when dob_can_apply is true (card is reference AND app DOB empty). BulkIdUpload — row.dob renders 'born X' only for self; dobBad warning renders when card dob ≠ app_dob; saveAll sends {card}_dob for self (birth_dob for card=birth); MismatchAlert shows a 'DOB on card' / 'App DOB' column pair.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/id_docs.py use_card_dob: priority check uses `_ref_dob(stored, skip=card)` then `DOB_PRIORITY.index(ref) < DOB_PRIORITY.index(card)` — correctly 409s when a higher card has a DOB. One subtle corner: if the SAME card (e.g. passport) already has a stored passport_dob and admin posts a DIFFERENT dob to /self/passport/use-dob, the route happily sets users.date_of_birth to the new value without warning. Not a bug per spec, but worth noting (spec says 'only fills EMPTY app DOB'; app DOB is still empty here so this is actually correct behaviour — flagging only for awareness).

routes/id_docs.py upload_scan: the `$unset` of `{card}_dob` on every re-upload only runs when `card != 'birth'` — birth_dob is editable so it is preserved intentionally. Good. The matching detected.dob_can_apply logic reads from AFTER-store state (`stored = ((await _doc(mid)).get('people', {}).get('self') or {})`), so the just-uploaded card's own dob is already stored at this point. Hence `higher = [c for c in DOB_PRIORITY[:idx] if stored.get(DOB_KEY[c])]` correctly excludes the current card by slicing up to its own index — nice.

routes/id_docs.py _store_read for card='birth': the DOB auto-store branch `card != 'birth' or only_missing is not None` means a fresh upload won't auto-fill birth_dob (admin confirms via DetectedBar which calls save() with birth_dob extra), but a reread CAN fill a missing birth_dob. This matches the spec that birth_dob is editable but reread-names fills missing DOBs. Correct.
routes/id_docs.py name_report: parent rows don't emit `dob`/`dob_match` on card cells (controlled by `if self_:` block). Spec says 'Parent rows have no dob fields.' — honoured.

services/id_ocr.py: Aadhaar prompt explicitly asks Gemini to return null when only year-of-birth is printed. Not unit-tested here (needs a hand-crafted real Aadhaar scan with just YoB) but the prompt wording is correct.

IdDocsSection.jsx: `const refDob = DOB_PRIORITY.map((c) => selfDocs[DOB_KEY[c]]).find(Boolean) || ''` correctly computes the first-on-file DOB; `wantDob = doc.app_dob || refDob`. The IdCardField's cardDob/wantDob prop pair makes the mismatch pill show up red when cards disagree even if app DOB isn't set yet. Nice.

BulkIdUpload.jsx dobBad: compares `r.dob !== slotOf(slots, r).app_dob` — but doesn't check whether app_dob is empty. If app has no DOB, `app_dob` is '' and the row's dob is a date string → dobBad becomes true → row shows red 'DOB ≠ app ()'. This would be a confusing warning. Suggest guarding: `r.dob && slotOf.app_dob && r.dob !== slotOf.app_dob` (the trailing `&& r.dob !== ...` is already there but `slotOf(slots,r)?.app_dob` is truthy-checked before the compare, so '' app_dob short-circuits — actually re-reading, the chained condition does `isSelf(r) && r.dob && slotOf(slots, r)?.app_dob && r.dob !== slotOf(slots, r).app_dob` → the `slotOf(...)?.app_dob` falsy check already handles '' case. Fine.

Index.css yellow rule: the selector is broad enough to also color number/date/time inputs (good) but it is placed OUTSIDE @layer so it beats tailwind utilities (comment confirms intent). It explicitly excludes checkboxes/radios/file/range/color/hidden/submit/button/reset types plus :disabled and [readonly]. Verified live: computed bg = rgb(255,241,118) across login, members, approvals, id-docs name-report search; readonly/disabled inputs not sampled on tested pages (none visible).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (yellow input bg + ID docs tabs + Name & DOB filters + approvals name filter all verified live)
